BiblicalUsage: Chakkiym is the Aramaic word for wise men, the Magians of Babylon. The king commanded that all the wise men be destroyed, they sought Daniel and his fellows to be slain, Daniel answered Arioch with counsel and wisdom, and the four friends prayed that they would not perish with the rest of the wise men.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Babylon's wise men show what happens when wisdom cannot answer the king: the whole company is sentenced, and one praying man saves them all. True wisdom is not knowing the dream — it is knowing the God who gives it.
